description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling media input files, including image and PDF processing, MIME type normalization, size validation, and fetching resources with size limits.

methods.name: rejectOversizedBase64Payload
methods.description: Estimates decoded size of base64 data and throws error if it exceeds maxBytes.

methods.name: normalizeMimeType
methods.description: Normalizes MIME type string by trimming, lowercasing, and removing parameters.

methods.name: parseContentType
methods.description: Parses content-type string into MIME type and charset components.

methods.name: normalizeMimeList
methods.description: Converts list of MIME types to a set of normalized MIME types, with fallback to default list.

methods.name: resolveInputFileLimits
methods.description: Creates InputFileLimits object from optional configuration, applying defaults.

methods.name: fetchWithGuard
methods.description: Fetches a resource with size and redirect limits, returning buffer and MIME type.

methods.name: decodeTextContent
methods.description: Decodes buffer into string using specified charset, defaults to utf-8.

methods.name: normalizeInputImage
methods.description: Normalizes image buffer, converts HEIC to JPEG if needed, and validates MIME type.

methods.name: extractImageContentFromSource
methods.description: Extracts image content from base64 or URL source, validating size and MIME type.

methods.name: extractFileContentFromSource
methods.description: Extracts file content from base64 or URL source, handling PDFs and text.
